# FG-REVIEW-0031

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_migration_change_is_a_proposal_only` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自動修正はマイグレーション・バイナリ・保護されたパスに触れるため、コミットせず提案だけにしました。MR の表示を読んで、人が直してください。
- en: The automatic fix touches a migration, a binary file or a protected path, so it was not committed and is only a proposal. Read the merge request's line and fix it by hand.
- id: Perbaikan otomatis menyentuh migrasi, file biner, atau jalur yang dilindungi, sehingga tidak di-commit dan hanya menjadi usulan. Baca baris pada merge request dan perbaiki secara manual.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C14 (ADR-0017 §1.2, §2.1): the candidate was within the fixer's scope, but at least one changed path is a migration (`reason=migration`), a binary file (`binary`) or a protected path (forge's own configuration, CODEOWNERS, authentication or permission code: `protected_path`). Those are never changed by the bot; the attempt is `proposed` and the merge request's line names the paths.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge.autofix.proposed` (info) with `attempt_id`, `paths`, `reasons`. GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/autofix answers the same.

## 対処 (fix)

A person runs the fixer locally (the same command as the target branch's `autofix.fixers.<name>.script`) and pushes the change.
